# Forest International School Paris

> Forest International School Paris is an English-language international school in Mareil-Marly, west of Paris, welcoming children aged 2 to 14. Learning combines an international curriculum with daily nature-based education on a forest campus near Saint-Germain-en-Laye.

- Address: 28 Rue de Tour d'Echelle, 78750 Mareil-Marly, France
- Phone: +33 6 32 72 51 45
- Email: discover@forestinternationalschool.com
- Instagram: @the_forestinternational_school
- Teaching language: English, with French lessons included (4.5 hours per week in Early Years)

## Programmes

- [Early Years, ages 2-5](https://forest-international.com/early-years/): Nursery (2-4) and Pre-School (4-5); project-based play with daily forest time
- [Primary School, ages 6-11](https://forest-international.com/primary/): English National Curriculum combined with the International Primary Curriculum (IPC)
- [Middle School, ages 11-14](https://forest-international.com/middle-school/): English National Curriculum with the International Middle Years Curriculum (IMYC)

## Holiday camps and activities

- [Holiday Camps](https://forest-international.com/holiday-camps/): English-language camps in summer, autumn, winter and spring, open to all children aged 2-12 — enrolment at the school is not required. Current dates, hours and weekly rates are published on the page.
- Wednesday MasterClasses: weekly English enrichment workshops during term time

## Admissions and fees

- [Admissions](https://forest-international.com/admissions/): applications are open year-round; school visits can be booked
- [Tuition Fees](https://forest-international.com/tuition/): annual fees published openly; payment plans and scholarships available based on financial assessment
- [Contact](https://forest-international.com/contact/)
